text: This run looked at the voice-agents page for a collections business owner in banks and lenders who wants more visitors to start building. In the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15), questions A3-proof and A4-cta failed because the copy lacks proof and a clear button action. The writer tried three angles: Variant A stressed speed to live, Variant B stressed system connection, and Variant C stressed trust and control. Jev and Judge 2 decided that Variant B passed because both judges found it better than the saved hero. Variant C was held because the judges disagreed, while Variant A failed Gate 2 because its gains were too low.
